$comment: What tools/scripts/generate-native-contracts.mjs emits for the native apps (docs/mobile/native-architecture.md §5). Every module must be on tools/scripts/mobile-pure-modules.json. `types` become Swift/Kotlin types, `values` become contracts.generated.json entries (typed by ContractValues). `ints` narrows a number field to an integer, `json` reads a field as raw JSON, `omit` leaves a field out; each names `Type.field` and must match a field the run emits. `optional` makes a field (`Type.field`) or every field of a struct (`Type`) decode when a stored document lacks it, and must match a field or struct the run emits. `listQueryCases` names the list declarations whose planner cases are recorded. `functionCases` runs pure functions over listed inputs (`args`, or `argsProduct` for every combination) into function-cases.generated.json, so each platform's formatter or rule replays the console's answers.
